proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: We bought six acres off FM 2493 that you couldn't walk into. Darrell spent an hour with us tying orange ribbon on the oaks we wanted. Every ribbon tree is still standing and the pad is exactly where the builder staked it.
reviews.name: Kendra L.

reviews.text: The yaupon under our pines was so thick the kids lost a soccer ball in it for good. Two days of mulching and now we can see clear to the creek.
reviews.name: Rusty B.

reviews.text: They sent a short video every evening showing what got done and what was next. I live in Dallas during the week, so that mattered more than anything.
reviews.name: Anjali M.

reviews.text: Nineteen stumps along the back of the yard, some of them old sweetgums with roots everywhere. Ground down, chips raked, and the yard was mowable the following Saturday.
reviews.name: Clint W.

reviews.text: Our pasture fence had disappeared into briars and saplings. They cleared ten feet on both sides of a quarter mile of wire and pointed out every post that needed replacing.
reviews.name: Bernice H.

reviews.text: Fair price, showed up when they said, and they walked the lot with me at the end before they loaded the machine.
reviews.name: Tomas R.

proof.guarantee: Any tree you flagged to keep that our machine scars, we take down and replace at our cost.
